scientific_question:
The owner resumed research on 2026-09-15 after the recorded pause. ACVC's one completed paired block on the private-information cluster host (five UAVs, fifty users, H256, J=S/256) reads F−M +.0234396496 J = F_ABOVE_MEI under the card's .01 J rule, with C−M −.0113099002 (DOWN), F−C +.0347495498, F−own-dwell +.0122213772, absolute C/F/own-dwell/M .3224744244/.3572239743/.3450025971/.3337843247 J, 22/64 adverse matched worlds (worst −.2115133 J) and conditional world SE .0104028 J. One training block estimates no training variation. The direction has two consumed recasts and lowest sequencing priority.

The new fact since the pause is the first same-repository measurement of between-training-block variation of a within-block paired contrast: FSD's completed two-block factorial on the Scenario 1 host gave paired-contrast training SDs of .0785526 and .0929470 J and arm-level block differences of .06–.09 J. Different host, recipe and package; it indicates scale only. If ACVC's block SD of F−M is of that order, one more block cannot resolve a +.023 J effect (two blocks give SE about .035–.057 J), and resolving it to ±.01 J would need tens of blocks at about 3,200 s native each.

What is the next direction object, if any, for the C/M family? The DM's options: (A) a replication series of k further independent unchanged paired blocks pooled under a prospective rule; (B) one fresh paired block of F and M at three times B01's training exposure with the identical 64-world sole-final panel also evaluated at 1× and 2× (evaluator state separate from training RNG), read as a sign-and-scale observation of whether F−M grows, holds or vanishes with training, ordinary plan about 5,000 s (F) plus 4,500 s (M) native; (C) no new experiment, record the one-block F_ABOVE_MEI as the family's terminal evidence and keep ACVC ACTIVE-idle until a Portfolio investment question. The DM recommends (B), offered for your challenge: it is the cheapest observation that changes the choice between continuing and closing the family before replication money is spent on an effect whose scale may lie below the host's training variation. Please also say whether (B) must include C and own-dwell arms to remain interpretable against the completed block, what its prospective reading rule should be (the DM proposes: F−M at 3× above +.05 J motivates a funded replication series at that budget; within ±.05 J or non-monotone motivates closing the family at its bounded claim; the 1× panel is a same-recipe replication datum for the completed primary and is reported, not pooled, unless a prospective pooling rule is fixed now), and whether any alternative object the DM did not list has higher decision value at comparable cost.
deliverable: Give one conclusion-first Direction decision at the smallest warranted scope and explain its strongest support, contradiction, alternatives and uncertainty. If you select (B) or another experiment, name the object with its class, arms, comparator, primary endpoint, reading rule with its declared MEI and reason, exposure in the runner's units (fits, training environment steps, evaluation panels, optimizer stages) and the ordinary cost plan with its measured basis; state what its each outcome would change and what it cannot establish. If you select (A), fix k and the prospective pooling rule and say what precision it buys under the stated variance alternatives. If you select (C), say exactly what claim the family closes on and what fact would reopen it. Use present timings only at their measured scope; unknown future cost remains explicit without a mandatory calibration experiment. Your selection is not an accepted source change, a launch, or a Portfolio action.
claim_ceiling: Current evidence is one complete paired B block: an MEI-sized F−M package advantage at the early endpoint on the private-information cluster host, with C alone trailing M. It is not stable superiority, tuned same-information headroom, equivalence, a pure K/N/retrace/memory mechanism, or a cross-host result. This round selects at most one bounded next object for the C/M family, a replication rule, or closure of the family at its bounded claim; no C freeze, no specification change, no Portfolio lifecycle, capacity, priority, fusion or registration change, no reinterpretation of the completed block.
constraints: Evidence-spec sections 11.8–11.11 govern: one or two independent training seeds are the default follow-up for a real bounded improvement, no seed must be positive, no universal seed count, estimator, bootstrap, significance or pilot gate; the card's own MEI informs comparison without rewriting its result branches; package versus component claims stay distinct.

The completed block's rule, panels, contrasts and limits are preserved verbatim; no historical pooling, rescoring or repair rerun of the unwired auxiliary counters (selected_final_checkpoints, M velocity_decisions, recurrent_observations remain unmeasured, not zero behaviour). An outcome-informed next object is permitted only under its honest label as a new object.

Consultation exposure: zero fits, models, checkpoint loads, environment steps, optimizer steps, tests or profiling; only static reading of the named fixed sources. Historical execution records cited: two originals, 2,162,688 native team ticks, 24,576 optimizer steps, native walls C 1670.62 s and M 1521.04 s, peak RSS 561,040 and 589,924 KiB.

Any selected experiment keeps the frozen host, legal information rights, native reward and termination, CPU FP32 single-thread numerics, remote-first WSL execution with exact committed source, per-invocation fresh memory admission of at least 4 GiB, detached supervision and separate evaluator RNG; a longer training budget changes exposure, not recipe, and interim panels must not consume the training RNG stream. Ordinary per-fit plans are not caps; measured walls are C 1670.62 s and M 1521.04 s at 1× budget.

The FSD block-variation numbers are a cross-host indication of scale, not ACVC's variance; treat any ACVC variance statement as an alternative to be weighed, not a measured fact. The 2026-09-14 reviewer preference for one more reference fit predates that fact and is not a decision.

Ordinary source and test budgets apply (2,000 new lines per attempt, 600 per runner, no new guard, registry, validator or telemetry beyond wall time and peak RSS). Under the 2026-09-12 owner instruction the DM implements directly with independent high-risk review; no CM/Implementer assignment is created by this request.

Deliver the complete decision through the connected GitHub connector as the task's delivery section states: the single scoped response file on the named branch and one Issue link comment. The chat reply is only the short delivery receipt. Do not echo request, task, conversation, routing or transport identifiers in the response body.
